questions.questionTextEn: For positive non-zero real variables p and q, if log(p² + q²) = log p + log q + 2 log 3, then the value of (p⁴ + q⁴) / (p² q²) is:
questions.questionTextHi:
[Logarithmic Identities • GATE Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —

questions.explanationEn: From log(p² + q²) = log(9pq), we have p² + q² = 9pq, so (p² + q²)/(pq) = 9. Squaring both sides: (p⁴ + 2p²q² + q⁴)/(p²q²) = 81 => (p⁴ + q⁴)/(p²q²) = 81 − 2 = 79.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (GATE Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।

From log(p² + q²) = log(9pq), we have p² + q² = 9pq, so (p² + q²)/(pq) = 9. Squaring both sides: (p⁴ + 2p²q² + q⁴)/(p²q²) = 81 => (p⁴ + q⁴)/(p²q²) = 81 − 2 = 79.

questions.questionTextEn: Five persons P, Q, R, S, and T are sitting in a row not necessarily in the same order. Q and R are separated by one person, and S is not seated adjacent to Q. How many distinct seating arrangements are possible if P and T occupy the two extreme ends?
questions.questionTextHi:
[Permutations & Seating • GATE Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
Five persons P, Q, R, S, and T are sitting में a row not necessarily में the same order. Q and R are separated by one person, and S is not seated adjacent to Q. How many distinct seating arrangements are possible यदि P and T occupy the two extreme ends?
questions.explanationEn: The two ends (positions 1 and 5) are occupied by P and T in 2! = 2 ways. The middle three positions (2, 3, 4) are occupied by Q, R, S. Since Q and R have one person between them, Q and R must occupy positions (2, 4) in 2! = 2 ways, forcing S into position 3 (which would be adjacent to Q). Wait—if P or T is between Q and R, then only 4 valid arrangements exist where S is at an end. With P and T fixed at ends, there are 2 × 2 = 4 arrangements of {Q, R} at (2,4).
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (GATE Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
The two ends (positions 1 and 5) are occupied by P and T in 2! = 2 ways. The middle three positions (2, 3, 4) are occupied by Q, R, S. Since Q and R have one person between them, Q and R must occupy positions (2, 4) in 2! = 2 ways, forcing S into position 3 (which would be adjacent to Q). Wait—if P or T is between Q and R, then only 4 valid arrangements exist where S is at an end. With P and T fixed at ends, there are 2 × 2 = 4 arrangements of {Q, R} at (2,4).

Let R[X², X³] be the subring of the polynomial ring R[X] generated by X² and X³. Consider the statements:
(I) The ideal ⟨X², X³⟩ in R[X², X³] is a principal ideal.
(II) R[X², X³] is a Unique Factorization Domain (UFD).
Which one of the following is correct?
questions.questionTextHi:
[Abstract Algebra (Ring Theory) • GATE Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
माना कि R[X², X³] be the subring of the बहुपद (polynomial) ring R[X] generated by X² and X³. Consider the statements:
(I) The ideal ⟨X², X³⟩ में R[X², X³] is a principal ideal.
(II) R[X², X³] is a Unique Factorization Domaमें (UFD).
Which one of the following is correct?
questions.explanationEn: In R[X², X³] (polynomially lacking the linear term X), X² and X³ are both irreducible, and (X²)³ = X⁶ = (X³)² gives two distinct factorizations into irreducibles, so R[X², X³] is NOT a UFD and ⟨X², X³⟩ is not principal. Both (I) and (II) are FALSE.

questions.questionTextEn: Let A = [[0, 2], [2, 0]] and let T : M2(C) → M2(C) be the linear operator defined by T(B) = AB. The trace and determinant of the linear operator T are, respectively:

questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (GATE Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (A) है।

questions.questionTextEn: Let y1(x) and y2(x) be two linearly independent solutions of the homogeneous second-order ODE y'' + P(x)y' + Q(x)y = 0 on [a, b], where P, Q are continuous. Which statement about their Wronskian W(y1, y2)(x) is always TRUE?

optionsEn: W(x) vanishes at exactly one point in (a, b)
W(x) is never zero on [a, b]
W(x) is a non-zero constant only when Q(x) = 0
optionsHi: W(x) vanishes at exactly one point में (a, b)
विकल्प: W(x) is never zero on [a, b]
विकल्प: W(x) is a non-zero constant only when Q(x) = 0
विकल्प: W(x) changes sign on [a, b]
questions.explanationEn: By Abel's identity, W(x) = W(x0) exp(−∫ P(t) dt). Since y1 and y2 are linearly independent solutions on [a, b], W(x0) ≠ 0, so W(x) is never zero on [a, b].

आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (GATE Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (B) है।
विस्तृत चरणबद्ध समाधान:
By Abel's identity, W(x) = W(x0) exp(−∫ P(t) dt). Since y1 and y2 are linearly independent solutions on [a, b], W(x0) ≠ 0, so W(x) is never zero on [a, b].

questions.questionTextEn: If G(x, s) is the Green's function for the boundary value problem −y'' = f(x) on [0, 1] with y(0) = 0 and y(1) = 0, then the value of G(1/2, 1/2) is ________.

[Ordinary Differential Equations (Green's Function) • GATE Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024]
प्रश्न (हिंदी अनुवाद): निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का विश्लेषण कर सही उत्तर चुनिए —
यदि G(x, s) is the Green's function के लिए the boundary value problem −y'' = f(x) on [0, 1] with y(0) = 0 and y(1) = 0, then का मान G(1/2, 1/2) is ________.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक हल एवं व्याख्या (GATE Mathematics (MA) • Feb 2024): सही उत्तर विकल्प (0.25) है।
